checkpoints.question: Is the document from the identified official issuer, with a traceable original location rather than an unverified third-party copy?
Are the complete title, original URL, document identifier, publication/revision date and version recorded?
Are commencement/effective date, withdrawal, supersession and relevant subsequent notifications established for this review date?
Are the 2024 FSSAI metals/trace-elements 09.xxx method-number collisions resolved using complete method name and source?
Does the named official method explicitly test the actual target analyte rather than an internal standard or unrelated parameter?
Do the original method text and exclusions permit the commercial matrix (including fat, dairy, water and processed forms)?
Is any official method adoption/mandatory-use order identified and precedence documented, not inferred from a hosted PDF?
Is an independent authorised reviewer documented to reconcile method/source evidence before any technical signoff?
Is the real manufacturer/supplier, registered unit and controlled material or marketed product code identified?
Does a current controlled BOM/ingredient identity record exist and match the precise sold formulation?
Are actual approved label, selling form and relevant FSSR/FoSCoS category supported by the manufacturer?
Are species, INS/CAS/EC, salt forms or crop/animal ingredient identity determined where the category requires them?
Can the physical sample be traced to the exact marketed product lot and processing stage?
Are fat, moisture, dehydration, concentrate or reconstitution factors determined for relevant test basis?
Are compound/mixture percentages and processed state evidenced rather than guessed from the category title?
Has manufacturer QA independently authenticated the commercial identity record and version?
Is the applicable original current notified Gazette, not just a compiled/consultation text, identified?
Are effective dates and subsequent amendments assessed as of 16 October 2026 rather than applying future dates?
Does the legal contaminant article actually match the sold commodity, not a related cocoa, fruit, milk, egg, salt or chemical analog?
Is the actual named metal, specific pesticide/residue definition, toxin compound or antibiotic molecule legally identified?
Does an authorised legal reviewer record the exact current limit, units and any dry/wet/fat-free basis for this article?
Are special-category, ingredient, composite, concentration-factor and food-specific provisions considered?
If an application/license status matters, are current individual applicant entries and supplier lawful basis checked rather than generalized?
Is there a separate dated, named Regulatory/Legal reviewer signoff with original source citations?
Is the exact accredited laboratory site/address and legal entity matched to the proposed test provider?
Is current FSSAI lab notification and any later 30 Sep 2026 notification checked for the actual lab, without relying only on the 7 Sep list?
Is its current valid NABL testing certificate number, status and any suspensions/withdrawals independently checked?
Does the published NABL scope include the specific food, ingredient or product matrix rather than broad laboratory competence?
Does the accredited scope explicitly cover the required metal, pesticide, mycotoxin or named antibiotic test parameter?
Does the scope name the actual method/version/instrument and required technique; are conflicting 09.xxx numbering schemes resolved?
Is demonstrated LOQ/sensitivity and uncertainty adequate for the independently signed applicable legal limit, without an invented limit?
Does original validation/verification show relevant recovery, precision, blanks and interference control on this matrix?
Were all accreditation, method scope, and laboratory notification statuses valid on the actual sampling and testing dates?
Is laboratory director or independent competent assessor review documented with source and method evidence?
Is there an authenticated actual lot sample, traceable identifiers and chain-of-custody with sampling plan?
Is the signed original CoA/report, laboratory identity, sample ID, test date and report version authenticated?
Do reported analyte, commodity, sample state and result basis match the signed effective CTR article?
Are lab current notification, accreditation and method scope verified for the exact test and sample date?
Are quantitative result, unit, detection/quantitation limit and measurement uncertainty adequately disclosed?
Is a legally applicable numeric limit, test basis, uncertainty and correct comparison documented without transferring analogous limits?
Are deviations, out-of-scope tests, failed results and sample discrepancies resolved via controlled deviation/disposition?
Has an authorised separate QA/Regulatory reviewer reached a documented lot-specific legal disposition after all prerequisite gates?
